main.description: A pre-defined policy workflow expressed as a GitHub Actions workflow (YAML). Used as the referenced record inside the RFP's policy field: an evaluator resolves the strongRef, reads the workflow, and runs its steps as admission gates in a sandbox. First-party/trusted by default, unlike com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.policies.denoWorker.

name.description: Stable name of the workflow, e.g. only-me, code-review-lite.

workflow.description: GitHub Actions workflow YAML. The engine parses jobs/steps and runs them as policy gates in the sandbox.

permissions.description: Sandbox capabilities requested by the workflow (net, fs, exec). Applied on top of the default deny posture.

signatures.description: badge.blue attestations over this policy record.
